players.product: foundation IP (SRAM compilers, standard cells) and high-speed interface IP

quarterly_data.signal: 2Q26 results (company deck): net revenue NT$421,850 thousand (US$13,305 thousand), up 6.9% QoQ and down 6.0% YoY; operating margin -4.0%; net loss NT$2,738 thousand; EPS NT$-0.06 (1Q26: -1.18). 1H26 net revenue NT$816,598 thousand, down 7.5% YoY; 1H26 EPS NT$-1.24. Company: revenue was down YoY due to delayed large projects, while increased R&D hiring led to a roughly 7% rise in operating expenses.
quarterly_data.figure: 2Q26 revenue NT$421,850 thousand (+6.9% QoQ, -6.0% YoY); EPS NT$-0.06

quarterly_data.signal: 2Q26 operating detail (company deck): royalties 17.8% of revenue, with the absolute royalty amount up 4.7% QoQ; fabless customers 81% of revenue, a five-quarter high (47.5% in 1Q26), and 64.8% of 1H26 revenue; 1H26 revenue from China and Taiwan up 34.5% and 14.3% YoY. 16nm-and-below nodes contributed 67.4% of 2Q26 license revenue, driven by AI vision, smartphone, AI accelerator, AIoT, memory and automotive chip projects in the U.S. and China; new sub-6nm projects with a leading foundry commenced during the quarter. Sub-16nm royalty revenue grew nearly 400% YoY and accounted for over 30% of total royalty revenue; the sub-16nm share of foundry license fees rose from 44.6% (2024) to 75.3% (1H26). Customers till 2Q26: 495 (472 fabless, 23 foundry); 130 new licences in 1H26, 1975 cumulative.
quarterly_data.figure: 16nm-and-below 67.4% of 2Q26 license revenue; sub-16nm royalty revenue up nearly 400% YoY; 495 customers

quarterly_data.signal: 2H26 outlook (company deck): M31 expects more leading-edge design starts from fabless customers in smartphone, sport camera and ADAS applications, and looks forward to its first collaboration with a U.S. IDM and new projects from the U.S. specialty-process foundry; it expects more meaningful advanced-node royalty contributions in 2H26 as customers ramp mass production.

Partner ASPEED: the company says ASPEED Technology's investment in M31 strengthens the long-standing partnership between the two companies and supports deeper collaboration in server interface IP, product development and customer engagement.
